Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: clean background for a top-down pixel billiards geometry puzzle. Create a single blank rectangular billiards-style board in wide 16:9 landscape. Entire board visible, narrow warm walnut stepped wood rail enclosing a large absolutely empty dark midnight-blue felt playing field. Symmetrical rectangular inner field, no perspective, no tilt, NO pockets, NO holes, NO white ball, NO target triangle, NO pickups, NO UI, NO text. Fine restrained felt pixel texture that never interferes with geometry readability. Minimal geometric brass corner details on the wooden frame, crisp integer pixel clusters. This is a background asset, not a game screenshot. Fill the canvas with the board; the outer board rectangle has a modest dark navy background margin. No elaborate scenery.

STYLE FORMULA (apply verbatim): Chunky handcrafted pixel art with crisp stepped edges and restrained two-tone shading, simple geometric silhouettes and consistent dark navy outlines. Use deep midnight-blue felt and warm walnut for the environment, ivory-white balls with cyan accents for growth and coral accents for shrinkage, golden-yellow targets, and violet crystal pickups. Lighting is gentle from the upper left, with a calm playful arcade mood. Keep foreground elements strongly contrasted, uncluttered, and readable at small sizes, always in a strict orthographic top-down perspective.

Constraints: authentic sharp pixel art; no soft gradients, no antialiasing, no 3D render, no watermark. Create only the single requested deliverable.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated game sprite, growth-state white billiard ball. A perfectly round ivory-white disk seen from directly overhead, centered in a square canvas with generous transparent padding, firm narrow dark navy rim and a thin cyan accent inset around its circumference. Only two stepped ivory shading tones and a small blocky highlight at upper left. Keep the visible ball silhouette precisely circular and centered. Pixel-art clusters should feel like a 32-pixel-diameter source ball. No numeral, no plus glyph, no arrows, no cast ground shadow, no cyan aura outside the circular ball, no perspective, no background objects, no text. Deliver true transparent alpha around the single ball, not checkerboard.
